questions.stem: What is the role of the coronary arteries?

options.text: They connect the atria to the ventricles inside the heart
They carry oxygenated blood from the heart to the lungs
They supply the heart muscle itself with oxygenated blood
They return deoxygenated blood from the body to the heart

questions.explanation: The coronary arteries branch off the aorta and supply the heart muscle with the oxygen and nutrients it needs to keep beating continuously.
